title: Understanding the Valid Index
text: To determine the valid index, consider which part of the shuffled indices should be used for validation in each fold.

title: Using Fold Size
text: The valid index should be a slice of the shuffled indices that corresponds to the current fold. Use the fold size to determine the start and end of this slice.

title: Calculate Valid Index
text: Use the fold size and the current fold number (i) to calculate the valid index.
